transform_function_for_params: use transform.transform to split a function into init and apply phases for parameter management
transform_with_state_function: use transform.transform_with_state to manage both parameters and mutable state in a Haiku module
strip_state_from_transform: use transform.without_state to convert a transform_with_state function into a params-only transform
wrap_transform_with_empty_state: use transform.with_empty_state to wrap a transform so it always passes empty state through
remove_apply_rng_requirement: use multi_transform.without_apply_rng to remove the RNG argument requirement from a transformed function's apply phase
